latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Image — Convert Free Images to Video.

- Instantly convert uploaded images or free stock imagery into 1080p videos via cloud rendering.
- Automatic setup with free credits; handles connection, authentication, and token management.
- Supports direct prompt actions: uploading, exporting, credits inquiry, status checks, and rich editing instructions.
- Tracks session state for repeat edits and allows batching or iterative workflow.
- Outputs MP4 and other popular formats with no export configuration required.
- User-friendly: no timeline UI or video software needed; just upload and describe your video.
